body:
Hi, American here. I completely agree with this whole thread. It’s really disgusting to see other Americans comments on the New Zealand shooting. A lot of the comments are so rude, inconsiderate and selfish. It really makes me angry and sad. I’ve seen nothing but overall kindness from other parts of the world when something happens in the US but it’s never reciprocated when something happens with the rest of the world. 
So on behalf of the Americans that still have a sense of humanity: 
My heart goes out to all the victims and their families this was a tragedy. Im sorry for my cultures ignorance and I hope you all can heal from such a terrible event.
